era: 2019 bestbuy.com (the 2018-2020 desktop design every visitor saw): royal-blue #0046be header with the yellow-tag BEST BUY logo, a white search field, utility links (Weekly Ad, Deal of the Day, Credit Cards, For Your Business, Gift Cards, Gift Ideas), a Products / Brands / Deals / Services row with Account, Shopping History, Order Status and Saved Items, yellow Add to Cart buttons, blue list titles and a pale footer with link columns.

sources.shows: home header: logo, Search Best Buy, utility links, Cart, Products / Brands / Deals / Services, Account / Shopping History / Order Status / Saved Items; hero carousel with pause and dots; free shipping / store pickup / same-day strip

2019 footer: 'Get the latest deals and more.' email + Sign Up, Best Buy app, My Best Buy (View Points & Certificates, Member Offers, Sign in or Create Account), Credit Cards, Orders & Returns (Order Status, Shipping Delivery & Store Pickup, Return & Exchange Promise, Price Match Guarantee), Support & Services (Customer Service, Protection Plans, Schedule a Service, Trade-In Program, Product Recalls), Partnerships (Affiliate Program, Developers, Best Buy Education, Best Buy for Business, Advertise with Us), International Sites (Best Buy Canada); Corporate Information, Careers, Accessibility, Terms and Conditions, Privacy, Interest-Based Ads, California Privacy Rights, CA Supply Chain Transparency Act; social icons (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest), Mobile Site, Give Feedback

header with store 'Bangor... Opens at 10 am', breadcrumb, All Flat-Screen TVs with Category / Current Deals / TV Type filters, Help tab
